description: Source code implementing a Vault class for secure key and data management, including import/export, creation, deletion, and handling of cryptographic keys with secure processor interactions.

classes.name: Vault
classes.description: Implements secure storage and management of cryptographic keys and data blobs, with thread safety and secure processor interactions.

methods.name: Vault::Vault
methods.description: Constructor initializing secure processor handle and internal state.

methods.name: Vault::Size
methods.description: Returns size of stored blob or key, considering sealing and exportability.

methods.name: Vault::Import
methods.description: Stores a key/data blob, provisioning cryptographic keys in secure storage.

methods.name: Vault::ImportNamedKey
methods.description: Loads a persistent key from a file into the vault.

methods.name: Vault::CheckNamedKey
methods.description: Checks existence of a persistent key by filename.

methods.name: Vault::CreateNamedKey
methods.description: Creates a new persistent cryptographic key with specified type and exportability.

methods.name: Vault::Export
methods.description: Exports sec object IDs for stored keys, with exportability and sealing considerations.

methods.name: Vault::Put
methods.description: Stores an encrypted data blob and assigns an ID.

methods.name: Vault::Get
methods.description: Retrieves an encrypted data blob by ID.

methods.name: Vault::Delete
methods.description: Deletes a stored key/data blob by ID.
